notes: Auth: the firebase CLI login (a project owner), so beginTransaction gives a PESSIMISTIC read-write transaction and security rules do not apply; end-user behaviour is not recorded here.
Times, durations and transaction ids are replaced by placeholders (normalise in lib.mjs, and the replace maps of record-f2.mjs); everything else is as returned.

aruma-ref-f2-commit/n1 is written {a: 1} by the setup commit; relations compare each later commit with it (commitTimeAfterSetupCommit, the write results' updateTime, and storedUpdateTimeIsSetup: whether a GET afterwards still shows the setup updateTime).
stored is a GET of the named document after the case (fields a, b, c).
limit.501_writes keeps only the shape of its request and response.
